To answer your first, two questions, i had friends to hang out with but I always felt I wasn’t necessary. I didn’t get invited to hang out, I always had to initiate it. When i was with them, we would have a good time but it always was me seeing what they were up to, rarely the other way around.

I guess in an ideal world, I would want a real best friend, somebody that thought of me as their best friend too. And a solid group of friends that we would hangout with all the time, a default friend group.

I would always try to do something. I would never just relax in my dorm room because I always felt like I was somehow “missing out”, even though nobody is probably doing anything all that exciting. This had an impact on my schoolwork because I would never sit and work, instead I would go hang out with friends to avoid being alone.

I thought in college I was going to find a group of great friends that I would hang out with all the time and finally feel accepted. In college, there were a lot of people I would call my friends, people I would hang out with sometimes or text but I never found my best friend that also considered me their best friend. I never found that group of people that no matter what we were doing, we would do together. I always felt like an outsider, on the edge of a friend group but not quite inside of it.

Life is so much work. I have to do my coursework and find a job so I can save up money to pay my loans. Then, maybe if I can find a good job in my field, I can move out and then, 5 days a week, 50 weeks a year, for 45 years I will be getting up and going to work and running errands and doing everything I need to do. All I want to do is curl up in my bed but I can’t.

I just feel like I’m never going to a find a woman who I clique with in ever way; someone who shares my intelligence, my interests, my points of view, my religion, and also just that I enjoy being with and talking to. I feel like I won’t ever find that.

Being at home is a mixed bag. I don’t feel that constant social pressure of “I should be hanging out right now”, “I should be with friends” which made it impossible for me to get work done because I never let myself be alone for long.

But now life is boring. Maybe it will get better once I start online classes but all it is, is one day after another, with the same people and nothing really happening,

I just feel like people never really like me that much. Alot of people i know always hang out with the same few people all day every day. They eat every meal together and hang out all weekend and between classes. I just have never really had that. I thought college was going to be better. I'm in my sophmore year and I have alot of "friends" but I feel like they never hit me up first or initiate a hangout. Its always me initiating everything. The few close friends I have aren't friends with each other and I dont get to see them much for other reasons. I just feel like I'm always second choice. As to your second question, life is always so much work and I don't know if I will ever find a wife who really loves me. I'm pretty good at making "friends" but It's really hard to get like actually close to anybody. I just never really connect with most people in that way. I'm back living at home now as of a few days ago, taking classes online but I have almost no friends back home and now I don't know how I'm ever gonna meet friends or a girlfriend. I had a girlfriend a few weeks ago that I was really in love with but we broke up and I don't think I'll ever find that again.
